newsitem.title: USA: ICN forms joint venture in China.
newsitem.headline: ICN forms joint venture in China.

text.p: ICN Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesday it will form a joint venture, called Wuxi ICN Pharmaceutical Co Ltd, in the Jiangsu province of the People's Republic of China.
ICN will own 75 percent of the new venture, while the Wuxi Pharmaecutical Corp will own 25 percent. Initial sales are expected to be US$25 million.
ICN said the joint venture will immediately begin building a US$24 million dosage form manufacturing plant in Wuxi. The venture will employ approximately 1,550 people.

"A key element of ICN's long-term business strategy is to move early into burgeoning pharmaceutical markets," said Milan Panic, chief executive at ICN. "By putting the infrastructure in place now, ICN will be uniquely poised to grow and profit as these countries turn to privatized pharmaceutical companies for medicines and other healthcare products."
The deal is modeled after two others undertaken in Yugoslavia and Russia. In both countries, ICN obtained controlling interests of local companies which were previously government-owned.
